id: Voice holds across the set: each book is one hand, and the two books sound like one project while each speaks in a tone for its own reader. The README additions blend into Bryant's text. The weak spots are where lab lore leaks to readers who have no way in: the house-number box, the unexplained "Corwin"/"the lab", C4 routes with no door, and the RECIPE's "Time will judge it". Two places are charming about a hole: the help key's stated customer (Watch everyone) has no page, and the council record is promised before it exists. The "Who is talking" paragraphs are honest and clear that the sheets are fictional and the AI wrote every word. They are confusing only because they name Corwin and the lab without introducing either; the RECIPE credits name Solberg-Maas without the word fictional. All of these are fix rows. None blocks.
